description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1973/45 of 29.06.2016, Kurunegala D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 420352
reasoning: This gazette exclusively contains amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It deals with specific modifications to land parcel details including ownership names, land classifications, extent measurements, and access rights for multiple properties in the Kurunagala District. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land title registrations, property ownership changes, and land classification amendments.
